mode: static preparation for combined864; no runtime/preview/CI executed

reports.binding: Request body exactly {startDate,endDate}; ready envelope {state:ready,validForMs:1..15000,source}; projectReports(source) validates period/cards/schedules/requests/changes/publications/attendanceSources/publishedWeeks. Capture actual owned ready response first.
reports.writeRule: Reports/export POST are read-only routes with exact period envelope; all nonallowlisted POST still aborted.

templates.transport: server-rendered GET; form actions are RSC POST to same page. Apply uses /api/schedule-copy POST with actor-bound JSON operation.
identity: Apply operationId,kind=TEMPLATE,weekStart,templateId identical across original/retry; localStorage key nevora-copy-pending:<actor>.
Do not craft RSC success wire payload; query feedback proofs do not claim backend submissions succeeded.
templates.gap: SSR failed/empty reads require fresh initial fixture or documented dev-only switch. Browser route cannot intercept server-internal data calls.

rules.transport: server-rendered GET; RSC actions held/aborted to same path before reaching server.
rules.identity: FormData captured before lock; original server-action binding unchanged; policy expectedRevision/scope remain identical; existing busy guard synchronously suppresses duplicate sends.
rules.gap: SSR failure cannot be forced by page.route; use explicit dev-only switch or retain gap.

update-detail.authorization: Keep captured X-Nevora-Communication-Authority; ready response authority must match and observedAt/validForMs1..45000 must remain valid.
update-detail.fixtureRule: Do not use original update for ON/BREAK/SWAP ready proof; require fresh before-listen recipient-grant verification.

compose.identity: PUBLISH/REVISE preserves original operationId,authority,draft,audienceFingerprint; REVISE also communicationId/expectedRevisionId. Retry body hash must equal original after lookup, not regenerate operation.
selectors: Publication needs a status check notice

payroll-settings.priority: Measure Company ready/pending/failure label/control geometry at320/200 in both engines; source savingId now changes text and may wrap. Do not assume focus fix preserves height.
payroll-settings.identity: operationId in localStorage nevora-payroll-operation:<recoveryScope>; command.current retains exact original input; retry hash identical; check receipt operationId must match.

payroll-runs.envelope: version=PAYROLL_API_V1,capabilities,runs[],jobs[]; preserve optional validated backlog and missingPeriods.
payroll-runs.binding: Capture real owned run id/revision/period/payday/reviewToken/rows and documents first. Browser-local cloned capabilities canReview=true,canApprove=false provides review-only branch without grant writes. All commands held/answered before server.
payroll-runs.fileInput: Import JSON built from captured run period/payday/rows and strictly positive fictional cent strings; shape NEVORA_PAYROLL_IMPORT_V1/USD,sourceName/sourceReference,rows employeeId,grossMinor,netMinor,employeeDeductions[],employerContributions[].
payroll-runs.identity: Preserve original operationId and all captured revision/run/job ids and payload bytes across retry. Receipt response with another id must not commit locally.

sharedStates: long names and fresh large variant
negativeMeasurementRule: After confirmed held request and real settled UI, missing control/focus/geometry is a completed negative assertion. Only absent fixture/transport/setup is a gap; never wait for absent fix as setup.

states: REVIEW_REQUIRED with real review token, provider rows/totals/no blocking exception
APPROVED with actual unpublished employee PDF
FAILED PREPARE job via actual canonical SCHEDULE_CHANGED worker failure
